gloss: close examination; careful scrutiny; thorough inspection

definitions.gloss: close examination; careful scrutiny; thorough inspection
definitions.explanation: Examining something in detail and with great care to verify accuracy or quality.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{精査|せいさ}してから{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: I will examine the documents carefully before making a decision.

examples.japanese: {データ|でーた}の{精査|せいさ}に{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to carefully examine the data.

examples.japanese: {予算案|よさんあん}の{精査|せいさ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A thorough examination of the budget proposal is necessary.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{精|せい} (detailed, precise) + {査|さ} (examine, investigate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{精査|せいさ}を{行|おこな}う - to conduct a close examination
・{精査|せいさ}が{必要|ひつよう} - thorough examination is needed
・{精査|せいさ}の{結果|けっか} - as a result of close examination
・{精査|せいさ}{中|ちゅう} - under examination

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{検討|けんとう} - consideration, review (more general)
・{調査|ちょうさ} - investigation, survey (broader scope)
・{吟味|ぎんみ} - scrutiny, careful selection
・{審査|しんさ} - examination, screening (often for approval)

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business, academic, and government contexts.
